SV_FAQ.q: How does MMC's marketing services work with MMC?
SV_FAQ.a: You do not have to buy everything. Start with the one that fixes your biggest leak: ad spend that rises while profit does not, visitors who do not buy, a brand that looks like everyone else's. A call settles where to start, and we plan the work so it survives the maths.

SV_FAQ.q: What does MMC's marketing services cost?
SV_FAQ.a: It depends on the service. For paid media, your ad spend is paid to the platforms and our fee is quoted after a call. For branding, packaging, UI/UX, web, app and Shopify, we quote per project after a call. For SEO, retention, social, influencer, reputation and UGC, we agree a monthly scope after a call. For lead generation and conversion work, we scope after a call. We do not publish a price list.

No. Nobody can honestly guarantee a ROAS, a ranking, a lead count or an admission. We commit to plans that survive the maths, accurate tracking, weekly optimisation and honest reporting, with results judged on contribution margin, not on what a platform reports.

SV_FAQ.q: Who is MMC's marketing services for?
SV_FAQ.a: Not only D2C. We work with D2C, B2B and education brands, and set the work up differently for each: D2C on contribution margin and repeat purchase, B2B on the cost of a qualified lead, education on enquiries, visits and admissions. See the D2C, B2B and education pages.

SV_FAQ.q: What do you need from us?
SV_FAQ.a: Access to your accounts or site, your margins or the value of a qualified lead or admission, and a named person on your side. We tell you on the first call exactly what is needed.
